entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Regex throw an exception `Specified argument was out of the range of valid values.` in compiled mode #119444
  • Consider to use `std::atomic` for simple cases in coreclr #119441

  • TickCount on macOS/Linux does not include suspend time #119437

Closed
